instruction: Review freecad_task-7_input.step in FreeCAD. Launch FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad` and open `freecad_task-7_input.step` there. Use the Part Design workbench for the modeling operations; activate or create the relevant Body, create new sketches for sketch-based features, and use feature or placement tools for the requested edits. Create four vertical through holes of diameter 6 mm in the thin cover plate. The hole centers must be 15 mm from the adjacent outside edges, at (15,15), (145,15), (15,85), and (145,85). Keep the 160 x 100 x 6 mm outside envelope unchanged and export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-7_output.step.
